theorem prop_9_3_2 {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) (δ : ℝ) {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {T0 : ℝ} (hT0 : max (10 * π * |δ|) 50 ≤ T0) (hG : GRHUpTo χ T0) :
    ‖Schar χ (fun n => ((Λ n * phi (n / x) : ℝ) : ℂ)) (δ / x) -
        (if q = 1 then 𝓕 (fun u => (phiPos u : ℂ)) (-δ) * x else 0)‖ ≤ err932N q T0 δ x * x :=

note: Thm 7.1.1 for the Gaussian is never used; Lean formalizes only the analogues for the weights the proof uses. Erratum: After (1.12) the book says η̂(−δ) is just √(2π)e^{−2π²δ²}, but its weights are one-sided (η♥(t) = 0 for t < 0, and the main term of Lemma 9.1.1 is ∫₀^∞η(t)e(δt)dt), so η̂(−δ) = √(π/2)e^{−2π²δ²} + i√2·D(√2πδ): 1.028806 + 0.551811i at δ = 0.1, against the remark's 2.057613. (checked by `scripts/checks/eq_1_11.py`).
